headline: Session done — aerobic target held, but drifting warm on HR
summary: 65min prescribed at 142-152bpm, cadence 172+: you ran 63min moving at avg 152bpm (top of band, not mid-band) and avg cadence only 85spm (that's per-foot; 172+ spm total matches it, so cadence target was essentially met). RPE 4, feel 2/5 — a flat course run harder than it should for an aerobic day. HR sat above target for most of the main set (12x4:44 laps averaging 153bpm, i.e. Z2/Z3 border), not a blowup but consistently hot. No pain/ITB signal reported, gym block presumably completed as prescribed. Wellness this morning was fine pre-session (HRV 70, RHR 45, sleep ~6.1h) so there's no red flag explaining the elevated HR — just a session that ran a touch warm.
flags: Ramp rate is now 3.81/wk, above the 6/wk hard ceiling isn't breached yet but is climbing fast off a string of 65-148 load days since the week-5 recovery dip — worth watching into Fri/Sat/Sun.

Three of the last four hard/quality days (Mon spin cut, Tue capped reps, today's warm easy run) have run slightly off-script on execution even as load numbers hit target — a drift pattern, not a crisis.
suggestedChange: Consider nudging tomorrow or Friday's easy effort down a touch (e.g. 5bpm lower ceiling or walk breaks) to let HR settle back into true Z2 before Saturday's key 900m descent session — confirm with Alberto rather than auto-adjusting.
